evidence: Frozen snapshot is byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools at HEAD 5e036ba0 (diff -r, node_modules excluded). instruction.md:3 promises 'six notes' and exactly six exist. Every graded capability is reachable from Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 (environment/Dockerfile), the empty seed, and public npm/CDN (task.toml network_mode=public; integration.md:5 permits frontend tools and CDN assets). The hardest items have a public anchor and a demonstrated path in the golden: preview isolation and refusal of eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import (security.md:3,5; golden uses a sandboxed allow-scripts iframe plus CSP, runtime.ts:378-393, server.js:16); endless-loop/time-limit termination (behaviour.md:5); durable repeat-safe restore (behaviour.md:13; server.js:95-116 stores restore_operations in SQLite). For a second reasonable reading I checked each criterion against its note: Ctrl/Cmd+A, needed by cw_newer_run_supersedes ('select all with the keyboard'), is public at ui.md:5; restore as a visible HTTP request, needed by both replay legs, is public at behaviour.md:13, and only restores (not saves) are replayed; Replace current moving on, self-containing replacement, grey-out after New and after opening, caret after Undo, the 3-second multi-caret burst ('however slowly I type'), and HTML whole-file line numbers all match their note text. The new cw_save_reload_restart replay after restart (judge.toml:344) requires the dedupe to survive a restart. That is the literal reading of behaviour.md:13 ('if the same restore request arrives again after it already went through ... it shouldn't create another revision', no time limit) together with integration.md:7,9. An in-memory dedupe map would violate that sentence, so it is not a conforming alternative. A base-revision design passes because a refused replay adds no revision. Conforming alternatives that fail: none found. Weak apps that pass: none found for this row. Rows 1, 25, 32 and 35 across the whole task: (25) grep over every .md/.toml finds no public or third-party address anywhere; only localhost:3000 and 127.0.0.1:3000, and app_context.md:27 says no criterion needs an address outside this machine; dynamic-import and fetch probes are local. (32) All four Run/Stop and Run/Run races (cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes; judge.toml:254,290,308,317) share one rule: a single code-runner action, void conditions stated, at most two more attempts, fail only if all are void. The only other repeat, the silent-probe retry in cw_preview_isolation:326, is bounded at one repeat with a defined outcome. No other criterion has an undefined retry. (35) cw_save_reload_restart now requires two saves, a restore through the app with the request recorded, a storage-clear re-read, and after the restart_app tool a re-read of current revision, fields, full revision list and revision one's source, then a replay that must add no revision. No other criterion uses the restart tool, and cw_shared_saved_record does a re-read after clearing storage and a second reload, which is adequate for a gate. (1) All six notes are now first-person requests ('I want', 'please', 'I keep the network panel open'). No must/fails/criterion vocabulary remains except behaviour.md:13 'must not overwrite a newer save', which is a natural requirement. integration.md still has terse runtime lines (port/0.0.0.0/health, the symbolic-link sentence at :11), which follow the template's runtime contract rather than a checklist. Looseness: the 5e036ba0 note rewrites keep every requirement ('must not require an install' -> 'I won't run an install or build step'; 'cannot read or change' -> 'shouldn't be able to'; 'with clear feedback' -> 'tell me clearly'). policy.md dropped 'Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract', but no requirement depended on it. In the criteria, the restart check got stricter and the newer-run retry only voids attempts that could not be timed, so the pass condition is unchanged. Nothing got looser for the model. Outside this row's verdict: raw-evidence-index.json is absent, and the scripted result JSONs for the new restart/replay leg are deleted from qc/repairs/.../results (only restart.log with the pid change remains). So there is no measured golden or judge result for the changed criteria on this candidate. That gap belongs to the runtime/golden rows, not to achievability.
